feed.title: The week in free proxies
feed.subtitle: How long free proxies stay listed and which sites let them through – checked about hourly

entry.title: The week in free proxies: Oct 12 – Oct 19, 2026
entry.content:
48,200 different type://ip:port entries passed every check at least once (many are ports on the same host). Of the 46,820 that left the list again, 88 % were not on the next list, and 39 (under 0.1 %) had been on it for 24 runs in a row (about a day) or more. 49 proxies on the list right now have been on it for 24 runs in a row or more.
In the last run Google let 60 % of the 297 HTTPS-capable proxies that gave a clear answer through – 55 % of datacenter exits, 66 % of the other exits.
In the last run Reddit let 50 % of the 253 HTTPS-capable proxies that gave a clear answer through – 23 % of datacenter exits, 93 % of the other exits.
In the last run Amazon let 28 % of the 365 HTTPS-capable proxies that gave a clear answer through – 23 % of datacenter exits, 37 % of the other exits.
In the last run Instagram let 28 % of the 359 HTTPS-capable proxies that gave a clear answer through – 14 % of datacenter exits, 55 % of the other exits.
In the last run TikTok let 62 % of the 297 HTTPS-capable proxies that gave a clear answer through – 85 % of datacenter exits, 28 % of the other exits.
In the last run Discord let 93 % of the 265 HTTPS-capable proxies that gave a clear answer through – 94 % of datacenter exits, 91 % of the other exits.
Between 622 and 4,195 entries were on the list at any one time. Right now: 1,290, 50 % of them tunnel HTTPS to the test host, 56 % are datacenter exits (the provider name looks like a hosting company).
Downloading 100 KB through the HTTPS-capable ones, counting the downloads that finished: half manage 34 KiB/s or more, the fastest tenth over 128 KiB/s.
Most exit IPs are in United States (294), France (99), Germany (97), Vietnam (96), India (88).
